mechanism.claim: A completed eight-hour increase in USDC+FDUSD execution-count share and cross-book count entropy marks a broadening of BTC price discovery beyond the dominant USDT book. When USDC and FDUSD aggressive flows agree during high BTC variation, follow their common direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed-block USDC and FDUSD signed taker flow
mechanism.why_distinct: CQSTL used signed BTC per execution and USDT ticket subordination and is terminal. Existing stablecoin relays use volume-normalized flow magnitude, ordered diffusion, or quote-volume participation. SQCBI triggers only on execution-count distribution breadth and entropy change; no prior event set or control is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC completed prior-24h realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed daily boundaries conditioned on cross-quote execution-count breadth are absent from Gross9 primitives.

features.source_panel: hash-bound official Binance Spot hourly panel for BTCUSDT, BTCUSDC, and BTCFDUSD
features.block: exact eight completed consecutive UTC hourly rows [D-8h,D) per symbol at D hour 00, 08, or 16
features.block_valid: all 8 rows source_complete, exact consecutive hours, finite signed_taker_flow_btc, integer trade_count, and aggregate trade_count>=80 for each book; no imputation
features.count_share: aggregate trade_count for each book divided by all-three-book aggregate trade_count
features.breadth_impulse: current alternative_count_share minus immediately prior valid consecutive block alternative_count_share; strict positive
features.entropy_confirmation: current normalized_count_entropy minus prior valid consecutive block entropy; strict positive
features.impulse_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute breadth_impulse over at most 90 prior valid consecutive transitions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.flow_consensus: completed-block USDC and FDUSD signed_taker_flow_btc sums are strict nonzero and same sign
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared completed-hour BTC log returns over 24 hours ending at D)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid decision blocks, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact D at UTC hour 00, 08, or 16 after all source rows complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cross-quote execution-count breadth impulse mechanism

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no symbols, block, trade floor, breadth, entropy, rank, flow side, hold, clock, volatility, or subset repair.
